_doc.purpose: Stopping rules (BLUEPRINT §4.6). Kept in a file rather than in code so that 'when does this thing give up?' is answerable by reading one small document.
_doc.max_attempts_per_case: Counted against attempts already made before the batch ran. The agent inherits a retry history it did not create and must respect it.
_doc.hold_if_late_auth_pending_hours: 72h = Razorpay's documented 3-day bank polling window. A payment marked Failed on timeout can still come back Authorized inside it, so re-presenting risks a duplicate debit. Razorpay's own retry engine waits for confirmation for the same reason. https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payments/late-authorisation/handle/
_doc.drop_if_expected_value_below_inr: Not worth the attempt. Escalations are exempt — a small merchant misconfiguration still needs fixing, and dropping it would hide a problem rather than decline a cost.
_doc.systemic_alert_if_same_cause_share_excee: If one cause dominates a batch the problem is one issuer, not N customers. Raise a single escalation instead of working them individually.
_doc.stop_on: Terminal states. Facts about the case, not judgements.
